name: main_injected_revision_sweep
description: Run the frozen main sweep of P3: rebuild the four treatments on the frozen province panel, inject one nested revision scenario of 1 to 38 cells through each treatment's own write mechanism, and measure the time, the bytes, the cells evaluated, the recall and the revision propagation of every point.

deduplication.requirement: every dropped row must carry the same value lexeme, the same decimal value and the same unit as the row that is kept
deduplication.keep_rule: order the candidates by retrieved_at descending then source_record_id ascending and keep the first
deduplication.reason: B3 keys its store by (cell_id, vintage_id) and two WebAPI variables carry the same indicator for the same cell

classification_columns.trace_id: empty; H5 revision traces exist only for the 14-cell evidence fixture
classification_columns.cause_family: empty; P1 classification lives at the H4 event level, not at the observation level
classification_columns.never_used_by: any treatment decision, score or metric

universe.ranking: sort by sha256(seed + unit-separator + cell_id), then cell_id; scenario k takes the first k ranks

protocol.execution: serial, one operator, no concurrent treatment run and no other workload on the node
protocol.baseline_rebuild: DROP TABLE ... PURGE for every sweep table, then scripts/h11_baseline.sh rebuilds all four treatments from the frozen panel view in one Spark session

baseline_mechanisms.B0: one MERGE per arriving panel vintage in vintage order, then expire_snapshots down to one
baseline_mechanisms.B1: one INSERT OVERWRITE per arriving panel vintage, each writing every state up to that arrival, retaining one Iceberg snapshot per release
baseline_mechanisms.B2: one INSERT OVERWRITE of the selection recomputed with the frozen H6B scores, then expire_snapshots down to one
baseline_mechanisms.B3: one INSERT per arriving vintage into the append-only store and one MERGE of the cells the lineage edges mark dirty into the serving table, then expire_snapshots down to one on both tables

injection.B0: MERGE the synthetic rows into the current table, then expire snapshots to one
injection.B1: INSERT OVERWRITE the complete table, that is every earlier state recomputed from the panel view plus the new full state, retaining the added snapshot
injection.B2: INSERT OVERWRITE the selection recomputed over the panel plus the synthetic rows with the frozen H6B scores, then expire snapshots to one
injection.B3: INSERT the synthetic rows into the append-only store, MERGE only the cells the lineage edges mark dirty into the serving table, then expire snapshots to one on both tables

protocol.b1_write_note: the frozen B1 mechanism is INSERT OVERWRITE of the complete state per release, so B1 rewrites every retained state on every revision; its earlier states are recomputed from the frozen panel view because a table cannot be overwritten from itself
protocol.dirty_cell_source: results/processed/h11-panel-impact-edges.csv, the observation_materializes_cell edges of the panel lineage plus the edge each synthetic observation inherits from its base observation

timing.boundary: in-session Spark SQL statement time reported by the Spark SQL CLI; JVM startup, catalog warm-up and view creation are excluded from the treatment cost
timing.source: Time taken lines of one Spark SQL session per treatment
timing.aggregation: median over repetitions, reported with the minimum and maximum
timing.claim_limit: comparative between treatments on the declared 2 vCPU VM at panel scale; never a performance, throughput or scalability claim

footprint.definition: bytes of every object reachable from the table metadata of retained snapshots
footprint.size_source: MinIO object listing of the table location

metrics.m1_recomputation_time: write plus maintenance statement seconds per treatment and scenario
metrics.m2_cells_evaluated: B0 and B3 evaluate only the cells their statement targets; B1 and B2 recompute every cell of the state they rewrite
metrics.m3_storage_footprint: baseline, after and delta bytes per treatment and scenario
metrics.m4_recall_rate: official plus synthetic requests answered with the exact published lexeme, divided by all requests
metrics.s4_revision_propagation_rate: revisions readable in the serving state divided by the revisions admitted in the run
metrics.cells_evaluated_note: H10B filled this column with the revised-cell count for B0 and B2; H11 applies the frozen m2 definition, so B2 counts every cell of the selection it recomputes

recall_after_revision.requests: every observation of the frozen panel plus every synthetic observation of the scenario

access.B1: observation_id in any state retained in the table, with the previous Iceberg snapshot checked separately with VERSION AS OF

recall_after_revision.reported_rows: aggregated per repetition, scenario, treatment and request kind; row-level detail is kept only for the revised cells and for mismatches

breakeven.question: at which revision size does the incremental treatment stop being cheaper than a comparator
breakeven.rule: report the smallest swept size at which the incremental treatment stops being cheaper; when no swept size crosses, report the direction that holds over the whole sweep and state that no break-even exists inside the frozen range

measurement_boundary.bytes_read: not measured; s2 stays outside H11 because the Spark SQL CLI does not expose per-statement read bytes on the frozen stack

invariants: every frozen evidence file still matches the checksum recorded in config/experiments/experiment_freeze.csv
the panel keeps 6983 observations over 5378 cells and every dropped duplicate is proven identical in value
the catalog is persistent and the working tree is clean before any measurement starts
every baseline rebuild reproduces the expected row, cell and snapshot counts of all four treatments
every scenario is a nested prefix of the next one and revises exactly one source
every post-revision state matches the state the Python treatment simulation predicts for the same scenario
every metadata-referenced object exists in MinIO with the size recorded in metadata
B1 retains one snapshot per release plus the revision snapshot while B0 B2 and B3 retain one per table
all repetitions are reported and aggregation happens only after row-level checks
timing is reported only for the declared environment and only as a comparison between treatments
